1.consolidated_definition: Planta trepadora de hasta 4 m de altura, con tallos sarmentosos, hojas alternas abroqueladas y flores en forma de capucha, de color rojo anaranjado, olor suave y sabor algo picante; se cultiva como adorno en los jardines y es comestible. (Tropaeolaceae; Tropaeolum majus).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Climbing plant reaching a height of up to 4 m, with woody stems, alternate spiny leaves and hood-shaped flowers in shades of reddish-orange, having a mild fragrance and slightly pungent taste; cultivated as an ornamental in gardens and is edible. (Family Tropaeolaceae; Tropaeolum majus).
